Aquapros - aquaproof
Aquapros

Waist pants with increased seam strength due to double-sided welding technique. Made of waterproof material, resistant to fats, enzymes and digestive juices. Comfortable elastic waistband to fit the wearer's body circumference. Practical vertical side slots covered with patches to allow access to pockets in garments worn under pants. Adjustable trouser leg girths with press studs.
